description: How many times one thing in a process was used or ran over a stretch, and how long it took.

app.description: The process (a telemetry_read's counted: added up over the stretch, by process, kind and name).

kind.description: What it is: a button or row used (part), a menu's item picked (menu), a screen opened (a page, a dialog, a side panel's page: screen), a wire op a host answered (op), a main-loop callback (callback), a function connected to a button, row or menu item, run as it was used (handler: by its name, with its click's time), a program started (subprocess).

name.description: Which, by the index every app shares: a part or menu item as Entity.kind/part name (schema/ui's: "Composer.region/send button"; Entity.kind/(what tells it apart) where it isn't one of its entity's parts), a screen as its entity ("Telemetry.dialog"), an op by its name, a callback by its function's (module.Class.method), a program by its file's name.

seconds.description: Their time added up: a part's or menu item's from its click till the app was free again (its handlers, and what they drew at once); a screen's in front, with someone at the machine; an op's handling; a callback's running; 0 for a program.

max.description: The longest of them (a screen's: its longest stretch in front).
